caption: The image is a promotional advertisement featuring a soccer player mid-kick on a stadium field, with a crowd in the background. The right side has a blue background with text promoting a Citibank and Coca-Cola fuel savings and gift offer at Esso stations. It details free Coca-Cola packs and contour glasses for April and May, respectively, for spending S$60 or more on fuel with a Citibank card. Logos for Coca-Cola, Cheers, FairPrice Xpress, and Esso are visible at the bottom. Terms and conditions are listed at the bottom left.

The image shows a person’s lower legs and feet, wearing red peep-toe high heels. Around the ankles, a large, yellow, crown-shaped Burger King logo is wrapped, featuring the brand’s circular emblem with “Burger King” text and a sunburst design. The background is a plain, light green. In the bottom right corner, there’s a small image of a chicken salad with grilled chicken, tomatoes, and cheese, accompanied by the text “check our new chickensalads” in colorful, stylized font.

This image is a promotional infographic for Dunkin’ Donuts’ “Flavor Radio!” campaign. It features the Dunkin’ Donuts logo, a white aroma atomizer, and a coffee cup surrounded by beans. The infographic explains how a jingle triggers a coffee scent via sound recognition technology in buses. Diagrams show the process: jingle heard → machine activates → aroma released → people choose Dunkin’ Donuts. A result section highlights 16% more visitors and 29% more sales. Photos depict buses, stores, and people. The background is brown, with orange and white text.

This McDonald’s advertisement features a vibrant red background with a runner in motion on the left, wearing a backpack. On the right, a large, colorful Southwest Salad is displayed in a bowl, surrounded by stylized black silhouettes of birds, chili peppers, and a compass. Text reads “A Taste That Inspires,” followed by checkmarks next to “New Trail,” “New Gear,” and “New Salad.” At the bottom right, the McDonald’s logo and slogan “i’m lovin’ it” appear, along with the phrase “The New Southwest Salad.” Abstract trail icons and floral patterns are subtly visible.

Three Pepsi soda cans are arranged in a diagonal line against a solid blue background. Each can features the iconic red, white, and blue circular logo and the word “pepsi” in white lowercase letters. Water splashes dynamically around and behind the cans, creating a sense of motion. The cans have a reflective surface, showing faint reflections on the ground. At the bottom, the slogan “REFRESH YOUR WORLD pepsi” is visible in white text. No people or other objects are present.

A clear plastic bottle labeled "ethos. WATER" with text "Helping children get clean water" is tilted, pouring blue water into a heart-shaped splash. The bottle’s cap is off, and water flows dynamically. In the top right corner, the Starbucks logo is visible. Below the image, text reads: “Your sip, their survival.” It explains that purchasing Ethos Water at Starbucks contributes 5 cents to the Ethos Water Fund, aimed at helping over 800 million people worldwide who lack clean water. No people are visible.

The image shows two hands holding Coca-Cola bottles, clinking them together as fizzy liquid sprays from the tops. Each bottle has a red label with a personalized name: “Kylie” on the left and “Luke” on the right. Condensation beads cover the bottles’ surfaces. Text on the left reads: “Share a Coke with a friend. Get in touch with a good friend, an old friend, or maybe even a new friend. shareacoke.com.au.” The Coca-Cola logo and slogan “open happiness” appear in the top right corner. The background is plain white.

The image displays a small, red cherry tomato with a green stem and a triangular slice of yellow pineapple against a plain white background. Text in green font states, “Dunkin Donuts is now offering a little bit more than just your morning donut. We now offer personal pizzas made just for you whenever you want one.” Below, the Dunkin’ Donuts logo appears with the tagline “more than coffee and donuts.” At the bottom, smaller text lists states where Dunkin’ Deli® shops are located: IL, IN, MI, NJ, NY, VA, WI. No people are visible.

This image displays “The Historical Timeline of the McDonald’s Menu in the USA,” with the iconic golden arches logo above. Various menu items are arranged: chicken nuggets, a dessert cup, three burgers (including a chicken sandwich), a side salad, a burrito, and fries in red boxes. Faint vertical text lists menu items like “Big Mac,” “Filet-O-Fish,” “McDouble,” and “Southern Style.” The background is white with subtle gray stripes. No people are visible. The composition highlights McDonald’s diverse offerings in the U.S. market.

This Burger King advertisement features two breakfast items: a black bowl filled with scrambled eggs, diced potatoes, bell peppers, sausage, and cheese, labeled “New BK™ Breakfast Bowl,” and a muffin sandwich with a sausage patty and cheese, labeled “New BK® Breakfast Muffin Sandwich.” The slogan “COME BACK and SHAKE UP YOUR WAKE UP.” is prominently displayed in red text. The Burger King logo appears in the top right. Fine print at the bottom notes price and participation may vary, and availability is during breakfast hours only. The background is a pale yellow.

A chilled Pepsi can with condensation droplets stands against a solid blue background. The can features the iconic red, white, and blue circular Pepsi logo and the word “pepsi” in lowercase white letters. To the left, the slogan “REFRESH YOUR WORLD” is displayed in bold, white, uppercase letters, angled diagonally. The can’s metallic surface reflects light, and its top and bottom edges are silver. No people or other objects are visible. The composition is clean and centered, emphasizing the product and slogan.

A white Starbucks coffee cup with a lid sits on a wooden surface, its green circular logo featuring a siren clearly visible. Below, in cursive, is “Taste of Inspiration.” The cup has small icons along its side and partial text at the bottom. No people or other objects are visible.

This Coca-Cola advertisement features a smiling man and woman seated closely, both holding glass bottles of Coca-Cola. The man wears a gray button-up shirt over a white tee, while the woman wears a red, white, and blue plaid shirt. They appear to be sharing a joyful moment, looking at each other. The background is solid red with white bubble outlines. The Coca-Cola logo and the hashtag #openhappiness are visible in the upper right. Text reads “happiness. coca-cola.” A QR code and social media information are in the lower right.

A woman with long, wavy brown hair and red lipstick sips from a Diet Pepsi can using a striped straw. She wears a blue dress and red nail polish, standing against a solid blue background. The image displays a promotional layout for Starbucks’ Braille menus. The image is a promotional advertisement with a pale yellow background.
